design.positives: TSNAdb v2 SNV-derived (Deep_imm>=0.5, MHCf_rank<=2%, canonical-10 alleles, seed=42 sample)
design.rationale: Neoantigen immunogenicity is mechanistically tolerance escape from self. Scoring TSNAdb positives against self-proteome decoys tests whether SESTRAV, trained on viral epitopes, transfers the discrimination signal across domains.
design.caveat: TSNAdb neoantigens are computationally predicted (NetMHCpan/MHCflurry-family tools). SESTRAV binding features partially overlap this prediction signal; the result measures presentation + immunogenicity transfer above self-background, not independently validated immunogenicity.
